name: Requirements Traceability Required
description: Source Code and Requirements Specification must trace to each other bidirectionally, with no undeclared orphans on either side.

conditions.statement: Every Source Code module traces to at least one Requirements Specification item.
Every Requirements Specification item traces to at least one Source Code module, or is explicitly marked Deferred or Rejected.
No Requirements Specification item remains untraced and unmarked for more than one release cycle.
